recognize_zh: CD20 染色中黏膜固有層被大片密集的棕色陽性 B 細胞充滿，把殘存的腺體（藍色、陰性）分隔包圍，並可見少數陽性細胞侵入腺上皮；黏膜內瀰漫 B 細胞浸潤合併上皮侵犯，是黏膜相關淋巴組織淋巴瘤（MALT lymphoma）的特徵。
features: Dense, diffuse CD20-positive B-cell infiltrate expanding the lamina propria
Residual CD20-negative glands separated and surrounded by the infiltrate
Focal CD20-positive cells infiltrating glandular epithelium (lymphoepithelial lesions)
Strong membranous staining of small to intermediate lymphoid cells
Loss of normal mucosal architecture with gland dropout
describe_en: CD20 immunostain of a mucosal biopsy highlights a dense, diffuse infiltrate of B cells that expands the lamina propria and separates residual glands, which are negative. Scattered CD20-positive cells extend into the glandular epithelium, consistent with lymphoepithelial lesions. The B cells are reported to co-express CD43 and BCL2. The findings are consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma).

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphoid hyperplasia (e.g., H. pylori gastritis)
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates contain well-formed follicles with a mixed T/B distribution, lack aberrant CD43 co-expression, and are polyclonal.
MCL cells co-express CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11, which MALT lymphoma lacks.
FL forms neoplastic follicles expressing CD10 and BCL6 with BCL2 in germinal centers, rather than a diffuse CD10-negative marginal zone infiltrate.
DLBCL consists of sheets of large transformed B cells with a high Ki-67 rather than small centrocyte-like/monocytoid cells.
